title: AlphaFold 3-Assisted Deciphering of the DNA Recognition by DREB1 Transcription Factors in Rice.
authors: Wang, Wenshu; Cai, Wei; Zhu, Jiang; Zhu, Yongsheng
one_liner_zh: 该文利用AlphaFold 3建模水稻OsDREB1转录因子与CRT/DRE/GCC-box DNA元件的复合物结构，结合突变与EMSA实验解析TF-DNA识别机制，高度契合本课题的TF-DNA互作建模与机理研究。
abstract: Rice genome encodes ten OsDREB1 proteins that regulate tolerance to abiotic stresses such as cold and drought. OsDREB1s can bind to the C-repeat (CRT) element, dehydration response element (DRE), and GCC-box in gene promoters for transcription regulation. However, the recognition mechanism of OsDREB1s to these DNA elements remains unclear. Here, the structures of OsDREB1s were modelled using AlphaFold 3, which revealed a typical AP2 domain and a disordered KRP/RAGR motif adjacent to AP2 in all OsDREB1s. Structure modeling of OsDREB1A binding to CRT, DRE, and GCC-box showed that four Arg residues and a Glu (E66) from AP2 play important roles in binding to the major groove of DNA, while R40 in the KRP/RAGR motif was predicted to interact with the minor groove. The structure models revealed a few differences in the binding details for CRT, DRE, and GCC-box. Consistent with these predictions, OsDREB1A was evidenced to bind with the three DNA elements in slightly different affinities through EMSA experiments. Mutation analysis verified the key role of R40 and E66 in binding to CRT. Considering the highly conserved structure and sequence of the KRP/RAGR motif and AP2, we speculate that the DNA recognition mechanism found for OsDREB1A may be common for all OsDREB1s.
abstract_zh: 水稻基因组编码十个OsDREB1蛋白，这些蛋白调控对冷、干旱等非生物胁迫的耐受性。OsDREB1s能够结合基因启动子中的C-repeat (CRT)元件、脱水响应元件 (dehydration response element, DRE)和GCC-box，从而进行转录调控。然而，OsDREB1s对这些DNA元件的识别机制仍不清楚。本研究利用AlphaFold 3对OsDREB1s的结构进行了建模，结果显示所有OsDREB1s均包含一个典型的AP2结构域，以及一个与AP2相邻的无序KRP/RAGR基序。OsDREB1A与CRT、DRE和GCC-box结合的结构建模表明，AP2中的四个Arg残基和一个Glu (E66)在与DNA大沟结合中发挥重要作用，而KRP/RAGR基序中的R40被预测与小沟相互作用。结构模型揭示了CRT、DRE和GCC-box结合细节上的若干差异。与这些预测一致，通过EMSA实验证实OsDREB1A与三种DNA元件的结合亲和力略有不同。突变分析验证了R40和E66在与CRT结合中的关键作用。鉴于KRP/RAGR基序和AP2的结构及序列高度保守，我们推测在OsDREB1A中发现的DNA识别机制可能对所有OsDREB1s具有普遍性。
